name: labs/fibsem-os__fibsem-os
title: fibsem-os remote fluorescence microscope
intro: fibsem-os remote fluorescence microscope, adapted from fibsem-os/fibsem-os. It reads `is_acquiring`, `is_interactive` and `acquiring_reason`; sets `exposure_time`, `binning`, `gain`, `channel_name` and 1 more; runs `start_acquisition` and `stop_acquisition`. `start_acquisition`: start continuous live acquisition of the fluorescence microscope. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/fibsem-os__fibsem-os --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/fibsem-os__fibsem-os --backend fake --mcp
